ABOUT ME

Meet your German teacher and job coach.

Hi, I'm Levent. I'm a German teacher and DAA-certified job coach. I help learners build the German skills and confidence they need for everyday life, work and new opportunities.

I know that learning German is about more than understanding grammar. That's why I created GermanForJobs: practical, interactive learning materials you can use at your own pace, with clear explanations, useful situations and personal guidance when you need it.

Because your success is my success.
